messages:
Sam (PM): Heads-up: Marco's two pilots pushed a hard ask: signed export bundles (manifest + sha256), BYOK handshake w/ no-escrow promise, retention lanes up to 7y, and an export SLA we can put in the contract. Need product decision today on which tradeoffs we accept for pilot.
Marco (Sales): Customers are ok paying for archive storage. Main blockers: (1) we must prove manifests are customer-signed or HSM-signed with chain-of-custody, (2) they want predictable export times for legal holds.
Ivy (Eng): Implementation reality: exporter will produce gzipped JSONL parts + manifest. Two signing flows: customer JWK sign (preferred) or our HSM sign if customer can't sign. Cost/risk: full-verbatim streaming is heavy; snapshotting+background export is safer for SLA.
Noah (Security): Security constraints: require customer key binding to tenant ID, replay-protected export tokens, and signed manifest entries with file-level hashes. Forensics note: if we sample content logs we must document gaps. Prefer customer-signed manifests for non-repudiation.
Priya (Legal): Contract needs: explicit "no default escrow" clause, export affidavit template, and retention-exception API (legal hold). Also define what constitutes a delivered export (manifest + checksums + signature).
Sam (PM): Proposal A (pilot-fast): produce signed snapshots + manifest, retention lanes (30d/1yr/7yr), BYOK handshake (upload pubkey -> challenge token -> confirm), export is async queue with pilot SLA best-effort <4h.
Ivy (Eng): Proposal A notes: rewrap on rotation w/o downtime using envelope keys. We'll add an export-priority flag for legal holds. Need schema signoff for JSONL fields before work starts.
Noah (Security): Add: default redaction policy (content_preview redacted) and a content_hash in each row. Sampling default: control-plane 100%, content 5% (opt-in to 100%). If customer requests 100% content we require a capacity/price addendum.
Marco (Sales): Customers want SOC2 attachments included in the bundle. Can we allow attachments folder in manifest? Also ask: can we do VPC BYOK (customer-managed KMS) for NovaHealth?
Ivy (Eng): VPC BYOK is heavy (networking + key access). For pilot we can support key import (JWK) and HSM signing; VPC-managed KMS will be a follow-up. We'll document the gap.
Priya (Legal): If we can't do VPC BYOK for pilot, include a risk acknowledgement in contract. I'll draft the addendum language for signature and export definition.
Sam (PM): Proposal B (longer): add on-demand <2h SLA, export compression/parallel assemble, gold/silver/bronze priority tiers, and optional verbatim stream for full-fidelity customers. This pushes ship time + infra cost.
Ivy (Eng): For Proposal B we need capacity planning, a parallel assembler service, and export checksum aggregation. Not recommended for pilot.
Noah (Security): For either option: signed-manifest schema must include: tenant_id, export_ts, list of files w/ sha256, signer_jwk_kid, signature. Also ensure manifests are immutable in export bucket.
infra-bot: Created ticket INFR-7719: "Pilot: evidence export + BYOK handshake" assigned to Ivy (Eng). ETA 6 weeks.
Marco (Sales): I'll confirm which customers need VPC BYOK vs JWK signing and push pricing. Also collecting required SOC2 artifacts list.
Ivy (Eng): Action plan for Pilot A: prototype exporter + manifest schema (this week), infra cost estimate (next Tue), staging run with synthetic TB tenant. Will post PR link.
Priya (Legal): I'll upload addendum draft by Mon EOD. Marking mandatory terms we can't waive.
Noah (Security): I'll publish security checklist (KMS patterns, token replay protection, sampling caveats) by Wed.
Sam (PM): Decision: go with Proposal A for pilot. Action items recap: Ivy - proto + cost, Noah - checklist, Priya - contract addendum, Marco - customer confirmations & pricing. Reconvene Fri 11am PT to review PRs. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
